scripts.ci: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.staging:deploy: pnpm staging:build && vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --cwd deploy/staging -e RELEASE=$(cat deploy/staging/release.txt)
scripts.staging:test: TEST_ENV_FILE=.env.staging TEST_TARGET=hosted bash -c 'for f in packages/testing/test/*.test.ts packages/testing/test-hosted/*.test.ts; do vitest run --config vitest.hosted.config.ts $f || exit 1; done'
scripts.staging:realtime: TEST_ENV_FILE=.env.staging API_BASE_URL=https://restaurant-management-staging.vercel.app TEST_TARGET=hosted vitest run --config vitest.hosted.config.ts apps/api/test-hosted
scripts.staging:e2e: bash scripts/env/fresh-restaurant.sh .env.staging https://restaurant-management-staging.vercel.app .staging-accounts.json && E2E_BASE_URL=https://restaurant-management-staging.vercel.app ACCOUNTS_FILE=.staging-accounts.json node --env-file=.env.staging node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test
scripts.release: bash -c 'R=production-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD); RELEASE=$R node scripts/deploy/build-vercel.mjs production .env.production && vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --cwd deploy/production -e RELEASE=$R'
scripts.demo:seed: bash -c 'eval "$(grep -E "^PROD_(DB_PASSWORD|POOLER_HOST)=" .env.production)"; export PLATFORM_DATABASE_URL="postgresql://postgres.lgoirbfyspuflqekrcgp:$PROD_DB_PASSWORD@$PROD_POOLER_HOST:5432/postgres" API_URL=https://bibiani-restaurant.vercel.app; tsx --env-file=.env.production scripts/demo/seed-demo.ts && tsx --env-file=.env.production scripts/demo/seed-demo-inventory.ts'
